BLOCKER: Re-review semantics under-specified: no defined identity/key for "same candidate" (what key: head SHA, commit range, or review id?) and no stated collision/tie-break when multiple reviews share a key; delta binding (`last_reviewed_HEAD..HEAD`) cannot be verified without it.

Design-pack enforcement is stated for "enforced items" only, but the mechanism/registry for which items are enforced, and how enforcement escalates (warn vs fail) at Gate 1 and precheck, is undefined — gate can silently pass on non-enforced items.

Encoding gate scope ("changed source/config/docs", "working-tree/untracked") lacks a defined change-set definition (diff vs index vs status) and a rule for files with no HEAD baseline (untracked/new), leaving the gate bypassable.
MAJOR: Risk "Delta review may miss interactions with unchanged code" is mitigated only by prose ("full-candidate AC context"); no concrete mechanism (e.g., dependency-graph expansion, invariant re-check over the full tree) is specified — interaction regressions can ship silently.

CL-006/CL-002 ownership split (reviewer-owned findings, main-thread-owned dispositions) is not addressed in the design; the delta review must preserve prior dispositions without letting the reviewer tool write them — storage/ownership model is missing.

Guardrail checklist items 3, 4, 9 (authz boundary, blast radius/dry-run, tenant isolation) are not explicitly answered or explicitly marked N/A; precheck "enforced items" should make an N/A decision explicit and auditable.

Rollback ("revert the commit") does not cover the persisted `item.design_pack` / generated `engineering/design/<ID>.md` or `last_reviewed_HEAD` state: a revert could leave orphaned design docs or a stale delta base pointing at a non-ancestor HEAD.
Observability is absent: no metric/log/trace for review-delta computation, design-pack validation failure, or encoding-gate violations — failures will be diagnosable only by re-running locally.
MINOR: Recurring MINOR "_render_review"/"_item_dispositions" untested paths (index alignment, missing item, unknown status) are not reflected in the test matrix; delta/prior-context rendering needs those exact cases.
"Generator reads templates BOM-safely" is asymmetric with the write-side guarantee (BOM-free output); specify both read and write normalization to avoid BOM reintroduction.
Affected-files list includes broad `test-framework/tests/test_*` glob — unreviewable scope; enumerate concrete test modules.
No decision record (ADR/decision entry) for choosing delta-review over full-review, though `docs/ARCHITECTURE-DECISIONS.md` is cited as a standard.
NIT: Probe/ID uniqueness via wall-clock nanos (recurring) — prefer monotonic counter or content hash for deterministic tests.
"No 1484 finalization code" boundary is prose only; consider an explicit lint/precheck assertion that finalization symbols are untouched.
SUMMARY: Design is directionally right (delta review, design-pack gate, encoding gate) and reversible at the repo level, but is not yet Gate-1-ready: identity/binding semantics, enforcement-vs-warn model, change-set definition for the encoding gate, and ownership of dispositions are unspecified. Top risks: silently non-enforced gates, delta reviews missing cross-file interactions, and revert leaving inconsistent persisted review/design state.
